In order to find a way to go around the Hag's trade, Johbla recruited the help of ten eager SeaFairer crews. He recruited them in Aranea Portum, and had them sail around the Fulcrid continent in order to be able to exlplore the sea they were paid to explore. The ships sailed around the continent in a matter of two months, with the only thing that slowed them down being stopping at Cervaportum to restock and rest and one ship captain wanting to explore an interesting bay along the way. Once the crews arrived, Johbla and a delegation of spiders set them up with supplies.

The meeting point with Johbla was just a week to the south of Aranea Portum, but due to a lack of passage from the Sea of Life to the Galewind Ocean, the crews had to sail around the entire continent.

Once the crews went off, the ten crews divided themselves into four groups. One group of sailors set of along the coast line to the west, which was largely unexplored and was rumored to be the home of the Fleet of Sin. Another group went southwest, where they planned to go along the western coasts of Seoti. Another group sailed south, hoping to find an eastern coast to Seoti not too far south of the Dynasty. And the last group, only composed of one crew compared to the others with three, went off to the east, along the coast, which was thoroughly mapped, out, and thought of as foolish to explore as many were sure there was no route there.

The group that went west set out, and the crew that was interested in the bay they originally passed was part of this group. They stopped, told the others to go on, and landed in the bay. The party that went to explore on land was near immediately assaulted by a pack of direwolves. Those that stayed on the ship had direwolves rush aboard at an astounding speed, an slaughter them as well. The second ship of the western group had swore they saw green people running around on some nearby shores as they were sailing by. That ship went off and sailed north, landing in the Chloran designated highlands. The captain of that ship was excited to bring back news of a new people they had found, not knowing of the Chloran's existence within their employer's domain. The third ship sailed off further west, past the continent and its western island, and was never heard from again. Some say the third ship was seduced into the joining the Fleet of Sins.

The group that had gone southeast had set out and found the eastern coast of Seoti. Two of the three ships went south along the coast, while one ship went west, and went into the bay. The ship that went into the bay crashed into rocks along the shores, and was forced to land. This caused the crew to be stranded, and die in the mountains of either cold or starvation. One of the two remaining ships also crashed along rocks on the eastern coast, but lagged so far behind the third ship, the crew was never rescued, and thus also perished in the mountains of western Seoti. The third ship went off south, and was said to have had its crew starve out, as they could not find sustenance further along the mountainous shores.

The southern group went off, going east enough to avoid the mouth of the bay, and kept going along the eastern coast of Seoti. One of the three ships had gone off into a bay, because the captain of that ship saw a cave, and wished to go inside it. That ship docked, and had sent an expeditionary force into the cave, only for the force to cause a rock slide that trapped themselves inside the cave, and destroyed their ship. The second ship of the group had saw the mouth of an extremely large river, and had decided to investigate. That ship went miles down the river, only to run aground, and stranding its crew. That ships crew died from exposure and lack of food, unable to dislodge their ship from the river bank. The third ship went further along the coast, and kept going. But the crew stopped, as they saw webs among the tree line. Confused, they came aground, armed, and scouted. The only webs they had seen were of the Fulcrid, and this land was unknown to the Fulcrid? Who could live here, the captain thought to himself.

The last group, the western group with its single ship, sailed along the coast line. They kept sailing, beyond the Barrier Forest, Beyond the Great Roost, and specifically beyond the Outpost. They sailed, until they found in anomaly on the shore. They had saw a large body of water, with a small strip of land separating it from the ocean. The ship landed, and sent out an expeditionary crew. This crew marched along the bank of the lake, until they had spotted another land bridge, marking another lake. This lake was then marched along until they saw what was too vast and salty to be considered another lake. After seeing the Sea of Tranquility, the SeaFairer crew knew they found what Johbla was looking for. The force went back, loaded onto their boats, and went back along where they came from, eager to report their findings. They may have found the key in outmaneuvering the Hag.

[Here is a map of the SeaFairer expeditions.](https://sli.mg/pCMzNh) The red Xs and arrows are to represent where the ships of those who perished perished. The red X with an orange dot represents where the third southern group ship landed. The red X with the green dot represents where the eastern group found the key to outmaneuvering the Hag.
